emergency.banner_text: In immediate danger? Call emergency services now.
emergency.quick_exit_title: Quickly leave this website and open Google
emergency.immediate_danger_desc: Do not attempt complex administrative steps if your safety is compromised. Prioritize your physical safety and contact emergency dispatch immediately.

home.hero_title: Empowering Women with Knowledge, Rights & Safe Guidance
home.hero_subtitle: Simple, calm, and legally accurate awareness information on rights, digital privacy, workplace safety, and verified emergency helplines.
home.core_domains_subtitle: Explore verified information across key areas of safety, law, and digital well-being.
home.verified_helplines_subtitle: Direct, toll-free national emergency lines across India.

rights.page_subtitle: Educational awareness on domestic safety, workplace rights, cyber security, stalking protections, and financial fraud prevention.
rights.search_placeholder: Search topics by keyword (e.g. Domestic, Cyber, POSH, Stalking)...

whatToDo.page_subtitle: Choose a general topic to see information and options. Do not enter personal details. This guide cannot assess your situation.
whatToDo.structured_guides_subtitle: Read comprehensive stage-by-stage reference documentation for formal reporting and documentation.

help.page_title: Get Help: Verified Directory & Support Services
help.page_subtitle: Access national emergency response (112), district One Stop Centres (Sakhi), cyber safety guidance, and statutory legal aid clinics.
help.priority_desc: Toll-free 24/7 nationwide emergency service for immediate police, fire, or medical dispatch across all states and union territories.
help.search_placeholder: Search helplines by name, category, or service...

faq.page_subtitle: Common questions regarding police station procedures, Zero FIR, free legal aid, cyber crime lodging, and the scope of this awareness portal.
faq.search_placeholder: Search questions (e.g. Zero FIR, Night Arrest)...

quiz.page_subtitle: Test your knowledge of women's constitutional protections, workplace rules, cyber security measures, and emergency protocols.
quiz.note: These interactive questions are designed to reinforce awareness of real statutory rights and procedural guidelines in India. No scores or personal answers are stored on any server.

laws.page_subtitle: Plain-language overviews of significant acts protecting women across domestic, workplace, and digital environments.

footer.about_desc: India-focused public awareness portal dedicated to women’s legal rights, cyber safety, workplace protections, and verified official help contacts.
footer.privacy_desc: No registration, no tracking of personal incident data, and no login required.
footer.all_rights_reserved: All rights reserved. Public awareness initiative.

common.global_disclaimer: This portal provides general awareness information only. It is not legal, medical, counselling, police, or emergency advice.
